name: extract_page_tables
description: Extracts all HTML tables from the active tab and converts them into structured JSON arrays.
codeSnippet: return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table')).map((table, tIdx) => ({ tableIndex: tIdx, rows: Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tr')).map(r => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('th, td')).map(c => c.innerText.trim())) }));
